requirements.evidence: The specification defines `class RateLimiter` shared by many threads, in-memory.

requirements.user_requirement: 60 requests per rolling 60 seconds per client key
requirements.evidence: R1 states 60 standard requests per rolling 60-second window per client key.

requirements.user_requirement: burst of 10, never more than 70 in one window
requirements.evidence: R2 states burst capacity of 10 and a maximum of 70 accepted requests per window.
R3: state is isolated between client keys.
R4: expired timestamps are automatically removed.
R5: rejected requests do not consume capacity.
R6: concurrent calls never allow capacity to be exceeded.
R7 and the constructor `RateLimiter(clock=time.monotonic)` provide injectable time.
